source_dataset: results/final_hardware_v1 (ESP32-S3 + E220-400T22D Sub-GHz LoRa, UNIFORM_BUDGET PASS runs)
provenance_note: Extracted unmodified from 24 PASS-audited ESP32-S3 + E220-400T22D hardware runs (6 paired hardware seeds x 4 channel regimes). Each outcome (1=ACK delivered, 0=TIMEOUT/dropped) reflects physical E220 RF framing/timing combined with EventGuard-LoRa's controlled gateway loss calendar.
